description: Deploy the 4 Supabase edge functions and run end-to-end validation. The edge functions are already written and located in supabase/functions/. A Supabase Personal Access Token (PAT) is required for CLI deployment.

userStories.title: Authenticate Supabase CLI with Personal Access Token
userStories.description: Log in to Supabase CLI using a PAT so that edge functions can be deployed. The PAT must start with 'sbp_' and can be generated at https://supabase.com/dashboard/account/tokens. Run: npx supabase login --token sbp_YOUR_TOKEN
acceptanceCriteria: Run 'npx supabase login --token <PAT>' successfully
Verify login by running 'npx supabase projects list' and confirming project ncyipufvutzghwgcxukg appears
If no PAT is available, check env var SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN
userStories.notes: Requires user to generate PAT at https://supabase.com/dashboard/account/tokens

userStories.title: Deploy validate-cartridge edge function
userStories.description: Deploy the validate-cartridge function to Supabase project ncyipufvutzghwgcxukg using the Supabase CLI.
acceptanceCriteria: Run 'npx supabase functions deploy validate-cartridge --project-ref ncyipufvutzghwgcxukg --no-verify-jwt --use-api' from project root
Command completes without errors
Function accessible at https://ncyipufvutzghwgcxukg.supabase.co/functions/v1/validate-cartridge

userStories.title: Verify all deployed edge functions respond correctly
userStories.description: Send test requests to each deployed function and verify they return valid responses (even error responses for missing data are acceptable - we just need to confirm the functions are live and responding).
acceptanceCriteria: curl POST to validate-cartridge returns a JSON response (not 404 or 500)
curl POST to load-assay returns a JSON response
curl POST to upload-test returns a JSON response
curl POST to reset-cartridge returns a JSON response
All responses include proper CORS headers
userStories.notes: Use service role key from SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY env variable (see .env file)
